specification.title: Matrix Snap Toggle Panel
specification.goal: always-visible Object Snap and Grid controls
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Matrix Snap Toggle Panel” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Matrix Snap Toggle Panel”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

windows_21_control_tooltips_2026_11_18.scope: The standard Windows application displayed all 21 expanded SNAPS tooltips, restored active End and Mid after an O-Snap off/on cycle, and showed Grid Snap, Ortho, Planar and Project in the compact row. Compact enable and expanded disable used the same Project state. Human M02-UI review remains open.

runtime_implementation.scope: The fixed Snaps palette is a two-way binding to SnapSettings: each object-snap icon is clickable while off, draws an active frame while on, and never owns a second solver.
remaining: Manual M02-UI review pending; no human sign-off is claimed.

standalone_verification_2026_10_22.acceptance: Clicking END in the palette changes the core enabled bit and icon state; turning snaps off makes the marker disappear.

palette_state_2026_11_18.scope: The expanded palette renders sixteen icons, the O-Snap master and four numeric Grid Snap step buttons. The fixture clicks all four step buttons, verifies that End and Mid dim with the master off, and verifies that End remains clickable and returns to full opacity with the master on. The compact constraint toggles also dim when disabled.

o_snap_master_icon_2026_11_19.scope: The expanded palette binds the authored SnapObjectMaster SVG to the O-Snap master. The active frame and dimmed texture follow the master, left-click preserves the per-kind mask, and right-click exposes the apparent Intersection option in both master states.

wide_o_snap_master_switch_2026_11_19.scope: The wider master switch shows I in its blue enabled state and O in its dark disabled state. Both ends toggle it, and right-click opens the same apparent Intersection option.

single_o_snap_mark_2026_11_19.scope: A single centered I or O represents the active or inactive state of the wide O-Snap switch.

windows_palette_2026_11_18.scope: The standard Windows window displays all 21 expanded controls. O-Snap off dims End/Mid and turning the master on restores both selections. The compact row displays Grid Snap, Ortho, Planar and Project.

snaps_menu_audit_2026_11_17.qualification: Historical technical_scope_complete is limited to its recorded fixtures; it is not current whole-menu acceptance
